env_configured.label: Configure environment variables (.env) — NVD_API_KEY is optional, raises the NVD rate limit

first_skill_run.label: Run /audit-feed-source to confirm a real CVE/security-news source is actually reachable

stack_profile_seeded.label: Run /update-stack-profile at least once to confirm the watch-list definition

first_trial_run.label: Run /scan-threats once and have Hamid review the real trial output before any cadence is enabled

onboarded.label: Deploy to Trinity (/trinity:onboard) — as a free-pool agent, per aegis-infra's tier assignment

auth_mode_confirmed.label: Confirm with aegis-infra/admin that OmniRoute free-pool routing (gemini-3.7-flash) is actually live for this agent, not just Claude subscription auth by default

first_remote_run.label: Run a skill remotely via mcp__trinity__chat_with_agent

schedules_configured.label: Enable /scan-threats on a cadence — only after the local trial run (first_trial_run) has been reviewed and approved
